Speaker: Lira
Text: Something changed today. The Fade pulled back — just a little. Like it was surprised.

Speaker: Lira
Text: I felt Dad. Not an echo this time — really felt him. He's closer. He's actually getting closer.

Speaker: Lira
Text: The Ethereal Realm has been changing me. I can feel magic in my bones now. The crystals respond to my voice.

Speaker: Lira
Text: I'm scared of what I'm becoming. But I'm more scared of disappearing before Dad gets here.

Speaker: Lira
Text: Keep coming, Dad. I'll keep the light on for you.
